items.text: Archie is on screen.
James is on screen.
No one is on screen except: Archie, James.
Exactly two people are visible: James in the doorway and Archie in front of the door.
James looks sixties: grey or white hair and lined face, not a young or middle-aged man.
James wears glasses, a waistcoat and shirt sleeves, with no jacket.
Archie is seen from behind, with no face visible, and stands between the camera and the door.
James stands in the doorway, facing out toward the camera.
James's gaze meets the camera or viewer, not Archie's back or the ground.
James's expression is flat, unimpressed and mildly put-upon, with no smile, shock or anger.
Archie's back is to the camera, and he faces the door and James.
The green door is open inward, swung into the interior and not outward into the street.
James's glasses are visible and one arm looks slightly bent or askew.
James's waistcoat has a small stain or mark.
The street, door frame and building match james_exterior.png, with nothing else in the street added or changed.
James is fully inside the doorway and clearly readable. Archie does not hide him completely.
The interior beyond the doorway is dim and shows no jars, shelves of jars or glass containers.
No legible text or logos anywhere in the image.
No player face is shown (the player is never seen).
Nothing story-critical sits in the bottom ~10% of the image.
The focal point survives the small-phone crop.
